tests.name: Select two adjacent unshielded target sectors

data.sql: SELECT w.to_sector FROM players p JOIN sector_warps w ON w.from_sector=p.sector_id WHERE p.name='photon_duration_qa' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM planets pl JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE pl.sector_id=w.to_sector AND COALESCE(c.planetaryShields,0)>0) ORDER BY w.to_sector LIMIT 2;

tests.name: Prepare eligible ship and exact ammunition

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Missile Frigate'),photons=3,destroyed=FALSE,onplanet=FALSE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_duration_qa');

tests.name: Move target owner to first adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{photon_target_600} WHERE name='photon_duration_target';

tests.name: Place photon target in first adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{photon_target_600},shields=0,combat_disabled_until=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_duration_target');
SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_duration_target';

tests.name: Fire with the configured default duration
Accept and persist the minimum one-second duration
Move target owner to second adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{photon_target_1} WHERE name='photon_duration_target';

tests.name: Move photon target to second adjacent sector without clearing disablement

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{photon_target_1} WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id};

tests.name: Fire with the configured minimum duration
Reject duration above the configured maximum
Verify persisted exact expiries and one debit per firing

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.photons=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photon_fire_requests r WHERE r.player_id=p.player_id)=2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM photon_fire_requests r WHERE r.player_id=p.player_id AND r.sector_id=@{photon_target_600} AND ABS(r.expires_at-FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.created_at))::bigint-600)<=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM photon_fire_requests r WHERE r.player_id=p.player_id AND r.sector_id=@{photon_target_1} AND ABS(r.expires_at-FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.created_at))::bigint-1)<=1) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sector_photon_effects e WHERE e.sector_id IN (@{photon_target_600},@{photon_target_1}))=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.name='photon_duration_qa';
